1970.notes: ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1970-71 ed. (M-57), Table 36 (State Individual Income Taxes: Rates, December 31, 1970), Table 37 (personal exemptions) and Table 38 (standard deduction). Rates (former G.S. 105-136, repealed by S.L. 1989-728) applied to each individual's net income after exemptions; joint returns were not permitted (ACIR standard deduction table footnote), so a two-earner couple paid tax on each spouse's income separately and the married figures here are for a one-earner couple. Deduction is the G.S. 105-149 personal exemption ($1,000 single; $2,000 married, ACIR exemption table) and percentStandardDeduction the G.S. 105-147(22) optional standard deduction of 10% of income up to $500 (an additional $500 was allowed a married woman with separate income). Dependent exemptions not modelled. The 3%-7% schedule is printed unchanged in the ACIR tables at Dec. 31, 1969, Dec. 31, 1970, Dec. 31, 1971, July 1, 1973 and July 1, 1976.
